PR #535 409 banner prefixes the advertised current value, so ?if= of that section 409s; true current 200s. Do not merge unchanged: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/pull/535#issuecomment-5467003366
PR #538 restores 409 CAS round-trip (advertised value wins ?if=), but Ruff F841/format and app.py 1020/1017 block merge: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/pull/538#issuecomment-5467193671

PR #532 replay protection follows retained room history (causal vs 1 MiB budget), but format and store.py 934/933 block merge: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/pull/532#issuecomment-5467405745
PR #541 omits empty MCP query '?' (causal vs main), but ruff format on the new test blocks merge: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/pull/541#issuecomment-5467554551
PR #483 UTF-8 test reads are causal on locale Windows (cp932 fails; encoding=utf-8 succeeds); rebase before merge: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/pull/483#issuecomment-5467735575
